what: For 01409 (stall watchdog counts query runs): blaze-query cannot depend on blaze-profile (blaze-profile -> blaze-v2-proof -> blaze-query is a cycle), so blaze-query now has `pub fn on_each_run(hook: fn()) -> Result<(), fn()>` (lib.rs), called on the running thread after each query function runs, never on a hit. Ask: where the daemon starts (crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/daemon.rs, beside plane::record_panics), add `blaze_query::on_each_run(blaze_profile::moved).expect("the one run hook");` (or ignore Err if a test process starts two daemons). Without it a check that runs over 60 s inside queries is a false stall.
